_meta.what_this_is: A tiny wiki-memory corpus for a personal assistant: ten short notes plus one long 'weekly-log' junk-drawer page that mentions a little of everything. Each query has one gold-relevant note id. The long page is the trap: raw term-overlap scoring inflates it because it repeats many common words, so it out-ranks the short, on-topic note the query actually wants.
_meta.docs_are: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored so length bias is visible: doc d00 (the weekly log) is long and touches every topic; the on-topic notes are short. Point the retriever at your own notes.
_meta.gold: the note id that actually answers the query

docs.d00: weekly log monday coffee then gym legs day. tuesday work on the retrieval project and coffee. wednesday gym push day and a dentist reminder. thursday flight booking research and coffee again. friday gym pull day, groceries, and pay the electric bill. saturday laundry and call mom. sunday meal prep coffee beans and plan the gym week ahead. general notes about work, coffee, gym, flights, bills, and the dentist all live here in this long running log.
